αἰγίδ: αἰγίς — aegis, Athena’s goat-skin shield; fem. acc. sg., elided (αἰγίδ’ = αἰγίδα)
αἰγίοχος: αἰγίοχος — aegis-bearing (epithet of Zeus; sense disputed); masc. nom. sg.
αἰειγενετάων: αἰειγενέτης — ever-born, everlasting; masc. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic -ῶν), epithet of θεῶν ’gods’
αἰθέρι: αἰθήρ — upper air, bright sky; masc. dat. sg.
αἰθέρος: αἰθήρ — the bright upper air, sky; masc./fem. gen. sg. (ἐξ αἰθέρος ’from the upper air’)
αἲ: αἴ (epic = εἰ) — if, would that; particle introducing a wish + opt. (αἲ γάρ ’would that’)
βαλέειν: βάλλω — throw, cast, let fall; aor. inf., epic βαλέειν (= Attic βαλεῖν)
βοὴν: βοή — shout, war-cry; fem. acc. sg. of respect: ‘good at the war-cry’ (βοὴν ἀγαθός) · also fem. acc. sg., direct object: ’shout’ (τεῦχε βοήν ’was raising a shout’)
βοῦν: βοῦς — ox, cow; acc. sg. (masc. ’ox’, fem. ’cow’)
γέροντας: γέρων — old man, elder; masc. acc. pl.
γίγνεται: γίγνομαι — come to be, happen, arise; pres. 3 sg. (χρεὼ γίγνεται ’a need arises’) · also copular, ’is, comes to be’ (φωνὴ … γίγνεται ’the voice is’)
γλαφυρῇσι: γλαφυρός — hollow; adj., fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις)
δήθ: δηθά (elided δήθ’) — for long, long since; adv., intensified by δή: ’for so long now’
δεῖπνον: δεῖπνον — meal, supper; neut. acc. sg. (περὶ δεῖπνον ’about the meal’) · also neut. acc. sg. in apposition to a preceding object: ’as a meal’
δηρὸν: δηρόν — for a long time, long; neut. acc. sg. used as adv. (accusative of duration)
δι: διά — through; prep. + acc., elided (δι’ = διά): ’through (the night)’ · also + gen.: ’through, through the midst of’ (δι’ αὐτῶν ’through the midst of them’) · also + acc., causal: ’through, by reason of’ (δι’ ἀφραδίας ’through folly’)
διέσσυτο: διασεύομαι — rush through, dart through; aor. 3 sg. (impf. in form), augmented (δια- + ἐ- elides to δι-): ’sped through’
διοτρεφέες: διοτρεφής — Zeus-nurtured (of kings); masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic διοτρεφεῖς)
δόρυ: δόρυ — wood, tree-trunk, timber; also spear; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., object: δόρυ χάλκεον ... εἰρυσάμην ’I drew out the bronze spear’
δότω: δίδωμι — give; aor. imper. 3 sg.: ’let her give’
δῦναι: δύω — go down, sink, set; aor. inf. act. (root aorist), of the sun: ’to set’
εἶεν: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 pl., in an indirect question: ’(who) they might be’ · also with κε, potential: ’would be’ (κ’ … εἶεν) · also in a concessive condition after εἰ: ’were’ (οὐδ’ εἴ οἱ χεῖρες … εἶεν ’not even if he had hands’) · also in a wish with a dat. of the person: ’may (they) be’ (ἔνδον ἑταῖροι εἶεν ’may my companions be inside’) · also in a plain condition after εἰ: ’there were’ (εἰ … βόες εἶεν ’if there were oxen’)
θύρετρα: θύρετρον — door, doorway; neut. nom. pl. (the plural for a single door)
θᾶσσον: ταχύς — swift; comparative adv. θᾶσσον ’more swiftly, the sooner’
κακοῦ: κακός — bad, evil; neut. gen. sg., substantive: ’the evil, the mischief’
κονάβιζε: κοναβίζω — ring, resound, clatter; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’rang’
κονίῃσιν: κονία — dust, ashes; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσιν (= Attic -αις)
λεγώμεθα: λέγω — speak, say, tell (of); pres. subj. 1 pl., hortatory: ‘let us speak’
λειμών: λειμών — meadow, grassland; masc. nom. sg.
μέλαθρον: μέλαθρον — roof-beam, roof; the roof standing for the house; neut. acc. sg.
μίαν: εἷς, μία, ἕν — one; numeral, fem. acc. sg.
μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
μηκέτι: μηκέτι — no longer, not any more; neg. adv., used with subj./imper. in prohibitions
μυρίοι: μυρίος — countless, numberless; masc. nom. pl. (later ’ten thousand’)
μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
μὰν: μάν — truly, indeed; epic particle (= Attic μήν); οὐ μάν ’surely not’
νέστορα: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; acc. sg.
ναίων: ναίω — dwell, inhabit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’dwelling’
νείκεα: νεῖκος — quarrel, strife; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic νείκη)
παντοίων: παντοῖος — of all kinds, of every sort; masc./neut. gen. pl.
πενταέτηρον: πενταέτηρος — five years old; masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ὗν · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with βοῦν: ’a five-year-old (ox)’
πετεηνῶν: πετεηνός — winged; pl. as noun, birds; neut. gen. pl., epic (= Attic πετεινῶν): ’of birds’
πολέες: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl., epic πολέες (= Attic πολλοί)
πόνον: πόνος — toil, labor, trouble; acc. sg.
σθένος: σθένος — strength, might; neut. nom./acc. sg.
σκοπέλῳ: σκόπελος — rock, crag, cliff; masc. dat. sg.
στήθεσσι: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
στήθεσφιν: στῆθος — breast, chest; neut. in epic -φιν, a case ending serving as gen. or dat. (= Attic στήθους); after διά: ’through the chest’
στυγερῷ: στυγερός — hateful, loathsome; masc. dat. sg., with μύθῳ
τευ: τις, τι — someone, something; indefinite pron., masc./fem. gen. sg., epic τευ (= Attic τινός)
τοιοῦτοι: τοιοῦτος — of such a kind, such; masc. nom. pl.
τρωσὶν: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. dat. pl.
τυδέος: Τυδεύς — Tydeus, father of Diomedes; masc. gen. sg. (Τυδέος υἱός ’son of Tydeus’, periphrasis for Diomedes)
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ (τῆς ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ’of which one part is a drying-ground’) · also with a name, article-like: ’that’ (τῆς Σκύλλης ’of that Scylla’) · also article-like with a noun: ’the, that’ (τῆς ληΐδος ’that booty’) · also article with αὐτῆς, ’the same’: τῆς αὐτῆς ἀγγελίης ’the same news’
φαίνεται: φαίνω — show, make appear; pres. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’appears, is plain to see’ · also + inf., ’seems (to be)’ (ἀρίστη φαίνεται εἶναι ’seems to be the best’)
φυγέειν: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. inf., epic uncontracted (= Attic φυγεῖν)
ἀΐδηλον: ἀΐδηλος — destructive, baneful (exact sense debated); masc. acc. sg.
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγορῇ: ἀγορή — assembly; fem. dat. sg. (Attic ἀγορᾷ)
ἀδελφεὸν: ἀδελφεός — brother (epic form = Attic ἀδελφός); masc. acc. sg.
ἀθηναίη: Ἀθηναίη — Athena; fem. nom. sg., epic full form (= Ἀθήνη)
ἀθρόοι: ἀθρόος — crowded together, all together; masc. nom. pl.
ἀκτῇ: ἀκτή — ground grain, grist (a different word from ἀκτή ’shore’); fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ, of means · also ἀκτή — headland, shore; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic -ῇ): ’on a headland’
ἀμέγαρτον: ἀμέγαρτος — unenviable, dreadful; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. sg.
ἀνθεμόεντι: ἀνθεμόεις — flowered, decorated with flowers; masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἀνστάντες: ἀνίστημι — stand up, rise; intrans. aor. part. masc. nom. pl., epic apocope (ἀνστάντες = ἀναστάντες)
ἀντιβίοις: ἀντίβιος — hostile, face to face, opposing; neut. dat. pl., with ἐπέεσσι
ἀπίθησεν: ἀπιθέω — disobey; aor. 3 sg. act. (= Attic ἀπείθησεν); with οὐκ: ’did not disobey’
ἀπρήκτους: ἄπρηκτος — not to be dealt with, without remedy; fem. acc. pl. (Attic ἄπρακτος)
ἀριστῆας: ἀριστεύς — best man, chief, champion; masc. acc. pl., epic -ῆας (= Attic -εῖς)
ἄνθεα: ἄνθος — flower, blossom; neut. nom. pl., uncontracted (= Attic ἄνθη)
ἄρηα: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρη)
ἄρηϊ: Ἄρης — Ares, god of war; masc. dat. sg., epic (= Attic Ἄρει)
ἄσπετον: ἄσπετος — unspeakable, vast beyond telling; neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὕδωρ (ἀ- + root of ἔννεπε ’tell’) · also agreeing with οὖδας: ἄσπετον οὖδας ’the vast ground’ · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with αἷμα: ’boundless blood’ (ἄσπετον … αἷμα)
ἐΰξοον: εὔξοος — well-polished, smooth; neut. nom./acc. sg., epic ἐΰξοον
ἐλθών: ἔρχομαι — come, go; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἐπονεῖτο: πονέομαι — toil, be busy with; impf. 3 sg. mid.
ἐφ: ἐπί (elided ἐφ’ before a rough breathing) — on, upon, over; + acc. · also + dat., with anastrophe (χερσὶ ἐφ’ ὕδωρ): ’over, upon (the hands)’ · also + dat. without anastrophe, ’over’ (ἐφ’ αἵματι φάσγανον ἴσχων ’holding the sword over the blood’) · also + acc., ’to, towards’, of destination (ἐφ’ ἡμέτερ’ ’to our (home)’) · also + dat., of the person favoured: ’toward’ (ἐφ’ ἡμῖν ἦρα φέρουσιν ’show favour toward us’) · also + acc., ’for, among’, of a share: κατὰ μοῖραν ἐφ’ ἡμέας ’according to what is fitting, among us’
ἑταῖροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl. · also voc. pl. (same form), address: ’companions!’
ἔγχεϊ: ἔγχος — spear; neut. dat. sg., epic -εϊ (= Attic ἔγχει)
ἔρχεσθ: ἔρχομαι — go, come; pres. inf., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθαι) · also pres. imper. 2 pl., elided (ἔρχεσθ’ = ἔρχεσθε): ’come!’
ἔς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; prep. + acc. · also with the adverb ὀπίσσω, ’for the time to come’ (ἔς περ ὀπίσσω ’even for the time to come’)
ἔχουσ: ἔχω — have, hold, inhabit; pres. 3 pl., elided (ἔχουσ’ = ἔχουσι) · or fem. nom. pl. part. ἔχουσαι · also fem. nom. sg. part., elided (ἔχουσ’ = ἔχουσα): ’holding’ (ῥάβδον ἔχουσ’)
ἕκαθεν: ἑκάς (ἕκαθεν) — far off, from afar; adv., epic -θεν (= Attic πόρρωθεν)
ἕλοντο: αἱρέω — take; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἵλοντο): ’took (for themselves)’
ἠβαιόν: ἠβαιός — little, small; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, almost always with a negative: ’not even a little’
ἠβαιὸν: ἠβαιός — little, small; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a little (way)’
ἡφαίστοιο: Ἥφαιστος — Hephaestus, god of the forge; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ἦρχον: ἄρχω — lead, rule, + gen.; impf. 1 sg.: ’I led’
ἰδομενῆα: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, leader of the Cretans; masc. acc. sg., epic -ῆα (= Attic -έα)
ἴομεν: εἶμι — go; pres. subj. 1 pl. (hortatory): ’let us go’ · also subj. in a temporal clause with ἄν/κε: ’we go, are going’ (ὄφρ’ ἂν … ἀγροὺς ἴομεν ’while we go through the fields’)
ἵπποισιν: ἵππος — horse; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι(ν) (= Attic ἵπποις)
ὀδὰξ: ὀδάξ — with the teeth; adv. (ὀδὰξ ἐν χείλεσι φύντες ’having bitten their lips’)
ὕλην: ὕλη — wood, timber, brushwood; fem. acc. sg.
ὥρῃ: ὥρα — season, time; fem. dat. sg.
ὦρσεν: ὄρνυμι — rouse, raise up; aor. 3 sg. act., augmented, with movable ν (= ὦρσε)
ῥέεθρα: ῥέεθρον — stream, running water, current; neut. acc. pl. · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’streams’ (δεινὰ ῥέεθρα)
